name: accordion-39
description: Help article accordion with a Was this helpful prompt that records a vote per answer.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ChevronDown as ChevronDownIcon, ThumbsDown as ThumbsDownIcon, ThumbsUp as ThumbsUpIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const answers = [ { value: "late", q: "My template sale payout is late. What should I do?", a: "Payouts can take up to 3 business days after the scheduled date. Check your bank details under Settings, Payouts.", }, { value: "fees", q: "What fees are deducted?", a: "Designali deducts a 2.9% processing fee plus 30 cents per sale before each payout.", }, { value: "currency", q: "Can I be paid in another currency?", a: "You can add up to three payout currencies. Conversion uses the mid-market rate on the payout date.", }, ] export default function AccordionHelpfulFeedback() { const [votes, setVotes] = React.useState>({}) return ( {answers.map((item) => ( {item.q}

{item.a}

{votes[item.value] ? ( Thanks for your feedback. ) : ( <> Was this helpful? )}
))} ) }
